name: reducto
title: Reducto
description: MCP server for Reducto, the agentic document platform. Exposes Reducto's document tools — parse, extract, split, classify, and edit — so AI agents can process PDFs, images, spreadsheets, and 30+ other file types as part of their reasoning loop.

tools.name: get_documentation
tools.description: Fetch Reducto SDK code examples, install commands, and response shapes by topic and language.

tools.name: upload_file
tools.description: Upload a local file or public URL for processing.

tools.name: parse_document
tools.description: Get all text, tables, and figures from a document as structured, citation-ready output.

tools.name: extract_data
tools.description: Extract specific fields into typed JSON with a schema, with citations on every value.

tools.name: split_document
tools.description: Divide a document into named page sections described in plain language.

tools.name: classify_document
tools.description: Categorize a document against a plain-language taxonomy.

tools.name: edit_document
tools.description: Fill forms or modify a PDF/DOCX, writing structured data back into a finished file.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Fetch a full, URL-backed, truncated, or async processing result.
